entries.en: to make into; to complete, to perfect
entries.notes: M choy 与 H『狀』音不合，疑为『做』(chòe) 之讹，即成做＝做成；L 义为完成、使完美。

entries.zh: 成器；成为宝器（喻造就成材、成全其事）
entries.en: to be made into a precious vessel; to be brought to accomplishment
entries.notes: M qūy 与『器』(khì) 对音有出入（疑『贵』kùi），H『成宝器』义尚明。

entries.en: to put one's hand to; to set about (a task)
entries.notes: L 作 perfeçionar 与『出手』难直接对应，M chun 疑为『伸』(chhun) 或『出』之讹，音标 T99 污损，义难定。

entries.en: to perfect to the end; to finish completely
entries.notes: H 第二字『竟』存疑（另说『究竟』），M 后半 sa ha vtin 未能解析。

entries.zh: 熏香、焚香（以香烟熏染）；香炉（焚香之器）
entries.en: to perfume, to fumigate (with incense); censer, incense burner
entries.notes: L 尾带 ~，疑为 perfumadero（香炉）之截断；M huân 与『爐』(lôo) 音不合，字形或本作『燻/薰』。
H『爐管』与 M cūy（疑『吹』chhui，即薰吹＝烟管）不尽合；17 世纪马尼拉 perfumar 可指吸烟。

entries.zh: 炉烟；香烟（炉中升起的烟气）
entries.en: smoke from a censer/brazier; incense smoke
entries.notes: M huân 与『爐』音不合，疑首字本作『薰/燻』。

entries.zh: 琼玉；美玉（perla 珍珠之美称）
entries.en: fine jade; precious stone (gloss for perla, pearl)
entries.notes: 『collada』语义未详（疑指串珠、镶珠），H 作瓊玉与珍珠义有出入。

entries.zh: 舌麻痺；舌头发麻（中风麻痹之症）
entries.en: numbness of the tongue; tongue palsy (perlesía)

entries.zh: 疯癫；癫痫（与中风麻痹相似之疾）
entries.en: madness, epilepsy; a disease resembling palsy
entries.notes: H 第二字存疑（瘴/瘢），M 作 chûn hóng，与 H 字序不尽相合。

entries.en: to let be; to allow (bóng: just let it be)
entries.notes: 以单字『罔』对 permitir，取闽南语 bóng『听任、姑且』之义，非经传本义。

entries.en: to permit, to allow; to approve

entries.zh: 纵；放任（听任下属、臣民自便）
entries.en: to indulge; to allow one's subjects to do as they please

entries.zh: 纵容；任其所欲而不加纠正
entries.en: to connive at; to indulge someone so as not to thwart him

entries.zh: 放他去；任他自去（任凭其为所欲为）
entries.en: to let him go; to let him have his way
